sloka: इत्युक्त्वा रावणसुतो वञ्चयित्वा वनौकसः।प्रविवेश पुरीं लङ्कां रथहेतोरमित्रहा ।। ६.९१.८ ।।
transliteration: ityuktvā rāvaṇasuto vañcayitvā vanaukasaḥ।praviveśa purīṁ laṅkāṁ rathahetoramitrahā ।। 6.91.8 ।।

translations.english: Ravana's son, a slayer of his enemies, having spoken to Vanaras in that way, in deceiving manner entered Lanka to get the chariot.
